script.text: Though Z-ARC was beaten, he was not defeated. He would resurrect to wreak havoc again, unless...
After Riley forced Ray's spirit from her body, Riley absorbed Z-ARC's spirit instead to seal him away.
And Yuya was freed from Z-ARC's control.
But she hasn't laughed or smiled since. It must be Z-ARC's darkness that won't allow her to feel even a moment of joy.
Yes. And if Z-ARC's darkness grows, Z-ARC will return to threaten the world.
There's gotta be something we can do. There's ALWAYS something we can do!
Not “we” – “you.”
It all depends on me?
Yes, Yuya. The fate of the world rests solely on your shoulders.
Your one last mission is to make Riley smile.
Make Riley smile?
If Z-ARC is darkening Riley's heart, then the only way to conquer it is to make Riley feel joy again.
And I believe only the best dueltaining can bring a smile to Riley's face.
The best dueltaining?
You'll have one final duel. One last chance to dueltain and make Riley smile.
If you succeed, I'll promote you to the pro ranks. But if you fail, then you must never duel again.
Never duel again? Well, that's a risk I have to take! Now who is it that I gotta face?
The only one worthy of such importance. Everyone, Yuya will now take his pro exam! And his opponent…
Will be me!
Remember, Yuya – to pass this test, not only must you win this duel, but you must also make Riley smile.
Got it. It's showtime!
